title: Sign-in tokens are stored hashed
description: Serves "Access is enforced everywhere.". Tokens stored hashed. Operator keys are JS-035's, from configuration.
acceptanceCriteria: No plain token in the database
A token read from the database does not sign anyone in: shown by trying one.
notes: Access: an operator key is never a user: an administrator's reads and account management, no playback or watch state. (access model, 2026-11-16)
